name: 360° Orbit — Product Turntable
description: Slow cinematic orbit around a product with dramatic reflections, like a launch film.
thumbnailPrompt: camera orbiting a premium product on a glossy black turntable, neon reflections
promptTemplate: Smooth 360-degree orbital camera move around {subject} resting on a glossy black reflective turntable. Slow, perfectly stabilized gimbal orbit, modular 8K digital cinema camera, 50mm prime lens at f/4 for clean edge-to-edge sharpness, {accent} accent lighting sweeping across the product surface as the camera circles, mirror-like reflections below, thin volumetric haze, luxurious tech launch film aesthetic.
negativePrompt: hands, people, jitter, warped product geometry, text, watermark, cartoon

referenceImages.hint: A straight-on product shot; the model will invent the rest of the orbit.
